findings.text: The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: RQCLA-10: the test file for it (claim-coordinator-unit-test.sh) has a lint violation at line 419 that breaks the test suite — `grep -cF 'pipeline.refused.claimed' "$_dscla10_runner" 2>/dev/null || echo 0` uses the grep-c || echo antipattern; `grep -c` already prints the count so `|| echo 0` can yield "0\n0", and `lint-grep-c.sh` flags it, failing `npm run lint` — plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/tests/claim-coordinator-unit-test.sh | _dscla10_emitted_note="(runner emits it: $(grep -cF 'pipeline.refused.claimed' "$_dscla10_runner" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) occurrence(s))". What would settle it: a change that meets this requirement in full.
